title: Audit event
description: One row of the append-only, hash-chained audit trail, as returned by GET /api/v1/workflows/{runId}/audit in JSON Lines form. There is no update or delete operation on this record anywhere in the system.

seq.description: Unique per run. This is what stops a restarted scheduler appending a duplicate.

actorType.description: Every action is attributed. An unattributed row would defeat the purpose of the trail.

action.description: From a closed vocabulary, so the reliability calculator can derive MTTR from these rows rather than from hand-entered numbers.

policyVersion.description: The policy set this run was evaluated against (REQ-D-003).

prevHash.description: The previous row's hash; all zeroes for the first row of a run.

hash.description: SHA-256 over this row's content plus prevHash. Editing a row breaks every hash after it.
